# What age secret keys the library redacts, and what it leaves alone.
#
# The ordered run the corpus writes credentials from cannot be written into a
# key: the Bech32 alphabet leaves out 1 and B, so the run here is 023456789ACDEF
# — 0123456789ABCDEF with those two taken away — repeated to the fifty-eight
# characters a body is. The case turning on the letters that run never reaches
# opens on the run and carries on through QPZRYXGTVWSJNKHMUL, which is what the
# Bech32 alphabet holds besides — every letter the run leaves out, in the order
# BIP173 states them.

patterns: age-secret-key

# The identity age-keygen writes, and the one it writes with -pq. Both are the
# secret half of a key pair: either decrypts every file encrypted to the
# recipient beside it.

case:     the identity file age-keygen writes
in:       # created: 2026-08-17T00:00:00Z\n# public key: age1023456789acdef023456789acdef023456789acdef023456789acdef02\nAGE-SECRET-KEY-1023456789ACDEF023456789ACDEF023456789ACDEF023456789ACDEF02\n
out:      # created: 2026-08-17T00:00:00Z\n# public key: age1023456789acdef023456789acdef023456789acdef023456789acdef02\n«age-secret-key»\n

case:     a key in the variable sops reads one from
in:       SOPS_AGE_KEY=AGE-SECRET-KEY-1023456789ACDEF023456789ACDEF023456789ACDEF023456789ACDEF02
out:      SOPS_AGE_KEY=«age-secret-key»

case:     the post-quantum hybrid identity
in:       AGE-SECRET-KEY-PQ-1023456789ACDEF023456789ACDEF023456789ACDEF023456789ACDEF02
out:      «age-secret-key»

case:     a key on the command line that decrypts with it
in:       echo AGE-SECRET-KEY-1023456789ACDEF023456789ACDEF023456789ACDEF023456789ACDEF02 | age -d -i - secrets.age
out:      echo «age-secret-key» | age -d -i - secrets.age

case:     a key in a json log line
in:       {"level":"debug","identity":"AGE-SECRET-KEY-1023456789ACDEF023456789ACDEF023456789ACDEF023456789ACDEF02"}
out:      {"level":"debug","identity":"«age-secret-key»"}

# The hybrid identity is read in the same places as the shorter one.

case:     a hybrid key in an environment assignment
in:       SOPS_AGE_KEY=AGE-SECRET-KEY-PQ-1023456789ACDEF023456789ACDEF023456789ACDEF023456789ACDEF02
out:      SOPS_AGE_KEY=«age-secret-key»

case:     a hybrid key written straight against a name
in:       KEY_AGE-SECRET-KEY-PQ-1023456789ACDEF023456789ACDEF023456789ACDEF023456789ACDEF02.
out:      KEY_«age-secret-key».

case:     a hybrid key in a json field
in:       {"identity":"AGE-SECRET-KEY-PQ-1023456789ACDEF023456789ACDEF023456789ACDEF023456789ACDEF02"}
out:      {"identity":"«age-secret-key»"}

# The recipient is the public half of the key pair, published to whoever encrypts
# to it, and it stays in the text wherever it is written.

case:     the recipient a key decrypts for
in:       age -r age1023456789acdef023456789acdef023456789acdef023456789acdef02 -o secrets.age secrets.env
out:      age -r age1023456789acdef023456789acdef023456789acdef023456789acdef02 -o secrets.age secrets.env

# The count behind the prefix is exact: a thirty-two byte identity is fifty-two
# characters of Bech32 and six of checksum.

case:     a body one character short is no key
in:       AGE-SECRET-KEY-1023456789ACDEF023456789ACDEF023456789ACDEF023456789ACDEF0
out:      AGE-SECRET-KEY-1023456789ACDEF023456789ACDEF023456789ACDEF023456789ACDEF0

case:     a run longer than the count is a key and what follows it
in:       AGE-SECRET-KEY-1023456789ACDEF023456789ACDEF023456789ACDEF023456789ACDEF0234
out:      «age-secret-key»34

case:     a hybrid run longer than the count is a key and what follows it
in:       AGE-SECRET-KEY-PQ-1023456789ACDEF023456789ACDEF023456789ACDEF023456789ACDEF0234
out:      «age-secret-key»34

case:     the human-readable part without the separator behind it
in:       AGE-SECRET-KEY-023456789ACDEF023456789ACDEF023456789ACDEF023456789ACDEF02
out:      AGE-SECRET-KEY-023456789ACDEF023456789ACDEF023456789ACDEF023456789ACDEF02

case:     the hybrid prefix without the separator behind it
in:       AGE-SECRET-KEY-PQ-023456789ACDEF023456789ACDEF023456789ACDEF023456789ACDEF02
out:      AGE-SECRET-KEY-PQ-023456789ACDEF023456789ACDEF023456789ACDEF023456789ACDEF02

case:     the hybrid prefix without its hyphen
in:       AGE-SECRET-KEY-PQ1023456789ACDEF023456789ACDEF023456789ACDEF023456789ACDEF02
out:      AGE-SECRET-KEY-PQ1023456789ACDEF023456789ACDEF023456789ACDEF023456789ACDEF02

# A key is read in the uppercase age writes and reads one in, out of the alphabet
# Bech32 defines. The two characters the run above is short of are two of the
# four that alphabet leaves out, and a body carrying either is no key.

case:     a key written in lowercase
in:       age-secret-key-1023456789acdef023456789acdef023456789acdef023456789acdef02
out:      age-secret-key-1023456789acdef023456789acdef023456789acdef023456789acdef02

case:     the separator in the body
in:       AGE-SECRET-KEY-1123456789ACDEF023456789ACDEF023456789ACDEF023456789ACDEF02
out:      AGE-SECRET-KEY-1123456789ACDEF023456789ACDEF023456789ACDEF023456789ACDEF02

case:     a letter the alphabet leaves out in the body
in:       AGE-SECRET-KEY-10B3456789ACDEF023456789ACDEF023456789ACDEF023456789ACDEF02
out:      AGE-SECRET-KEY-10B3456789ACDEF023456789ACDEF023456789ACDEF023456789ACDEF02

case:     a body carrying the letters the run never reaches
in:       AGE-SECRET-KEY-1023456789ACDEFQPZRYXGTVWSJNKHMULQPZRYXGTVWSJNKHMULQPZRYXGT
out:      «age-secret-key»

case:     a body carrying one lowercase character
in:       AGE-SECRET-KEY-1023456789ACDEF023456789aCDEF023456789ACDEF023456789ACDEF02
out:      AGE-SECRET-KEY-1023456789ACDEF023456789aCDEF023456789ACDEF023456789ACDEF02

# There is no word boundary either side of a match.

case:     a key written straight against a name
in:       KEY_AGE-SECRET-KEY-1023456789ACDEF023456789ACDEF023456789ACDEF023456789ACDEF02
out:      KEY_«age-secret-key»

case:     two keys with nothing between them
in:       AGE-SECRET-KEY-1023456789ACDEF023456789ACDEF023456789ACDEF023456789ACDEF02AGE-SECRET-KEY-PQ-1023456789ACDEF023456789ACDEF023456789ACDEF023456789ACDEF02
out:      «age-secret-key»«age-secret-key»

case:     three keys with nothing between them
in:       AGE-SECRET-KEY-1023456789ACDEF023456789ACDEF023456789ACDEF023456789ACDEF02AGE-SECRET-KEY-1023456789ACDEF023456789ACDEF023456789ACDEF023456789ACDEF02AGE-SECRET-KEY-PQ-1023456789ACDEF023456789ACDEF023456789ACDEF023456789ACDEF02
out:      «age-secret-key»«age-secret-key»«age-secret-key»

case:     a key flush against a multi-byte rune on both sides
in:       日本語AGE-SECRET-KEY-1023456789ACDEF023456789ACDEF023456789ACDEF023456789ACDEF02日本語
out:      日本語«age-secret-key»日本語

case:     a key in parentheses
in:       (AGE-SECRET-KEY-1023456789ACDEF023456789ACDEF023456789ACDEF023456789ACDEF02)
out:      («age-secret-key»)

case:     a key in a yaml value
in:       age_key: AGE-SECRET-KEY-1023456789ACDEF023456789ACDEF023456789ACDEF023456789ACDEF02
out:      age_key: «age-secret-key»

# What this pattern comes close to without becoming a candidate at all: an
# uppercase run in the alphabet's own shape, and a kind this pattern was never
# told about standing where PQ would.

case:     an uppercase base32 blob
in:       MZXW6YTBOI======MZXW6YTBOI======MZXW6YTBOI======MZXW6YTBOI======
out:      MZXW6YTBOI======MZXW6YTBOI======MZXW6YTBOI======MZXW6YTBOI======

case:     a kind this pattern was never told about
in:       BUILD_ID=AGE-SECRET-KEY-BUILD-1023456789ACDEF
out:      BUILD_ID=AGE-SECRET-KEY-BUILD-1023456789ACDEF

case:     prose naming a secret key
in:       the age secret key belongs in a file the repository does not carry
out:      the age secret key belongs in a file the repository does not carry
